title: Number Ninja
tagline: Slice through sums at lightning speed!
description: A fast-paced arithmetic arcade where number blasts fly across the neon sky and the ninja chops the correct answers.
instructions: Read the sum at the top of the arena.
Tap or click the correct answer before it zooms past.
Each correct slice builds your combo score.
A wrong slice costs one heart - you have 10 hearts!

slides.title: Neon Arena
slides.caption: Sums fly across a starry neon battlefield.

slides.title: Combo Slash
slides.caption: Chain correct answers to grow your combo.

slides.title: Boss Round
slides.caption: Tougher sums appear every third level.

slides.title: High Score
slides.caption: Beat your best score and climb the team board.

title: Fraction Forest
tagline: Share magical fruit to wake the forest.
description: A story-led adventure where friendly forest creatures ask you to split pies, fruit and treasure into equal parts.
instructions: Listen or read what the forest friend needs.
Choose the picture that shows the correct fraction.
Finish all 10 levels to light up the whole forest.

slides.title: Meet Maple
slides.caption: A hungry fox needs half of every pie.

slides.title: Split It Up
slides.caption: Pick the picture that shows the right fraction.

slides.title: Forest Lights
slides.caption: Each level you finish lights a lantern.

slides.title: Golden Grove
slides.caption: Complete every level to unlock the grove.

title: Pattern Peacock
tagline: Spot the pattern, show the feathers!
description: Colourful feather sequences appear on the peacock tail - choose what comes next to make the tail bloom.
instructions: Look at the sequence of feathers.
Work out what comes next.
Tap the feather that continues the pattern.

slides.title: Feather Parade
slides.caption: Sequences bloom across the tail.

slides.title: What Next?
slides.caption: Choose the feather that continues the pattern.

slides.title: Growing Tail
slides.caption: Every right answer adds new feathers.

slides.title: Full Fan
slides.caption: Fill the whole tail to finish.

title: Word Wonders
tagline: Fill the missing letters and free the words.
description: Glowing words float by with missing letters. Tap the right letter tile to complete each word.
instructions: Look at the word with empty letter spaces.
Choose the letter tile that completes it.
Use the speaker button to hear the word.

slides.title: Floating Words
slides.caption: Words drift in with missing letters.

slides.title: Letter Tiles
slides.caption: Tap the glowing tile that fits.

slides.title: Hear It
slides.caption: Every word can be read aloud.

slides.title: Wonder Book
slides.caption: Collect every word into your book.

title: Rhyme Time Rockets
description: Pick the picture word that rhymes with the word at the launch pad and send the rocket sky-high.
instructions: Listen to the word on the launch pad.
Choose the option that rhymes with it.
Ten correct launches complete the mission.

slides.title: Launch Pad
slides.caption: A rhyming word lights up the pad.

slides.title: Pick A Rhyme
slides.caption: Tap the picture that rhymes.

slides.title: Blast Off
slides.caption: Correct rhymes send the rocket flying.

slides.title: Moon Base
slides.caption: Ten launches build your moon base.

title: Story Stitch
tagline: Sew sentences into a shining story.
description: Sentences from a tale are shuffled - arrange them in the right order to stitch the story back together.
instructions: Read each sentence card.
Drag or tap them into the correct order.
Finish the story to earn a star.

slides.title: Shuffled Pages
slides.caption: Sentence cards tumble out of the book.

slides.title: Order Up
slides.caption: Place them in the order that makes sense.

slides.title: Stitch Together
slides.caption: Watch the story sew itself together.

slides.title: Shining Tale
slides.caption: Complete the tale to earn a star.

title: Science Station
tagline: Run experiments in a neon lab.
description: A friendly lab assistant poses real science questions - choose the right answer to power the machines.
instructions: Read or listen to the experiment question.
Pick one of the three answers.
Correct answers charge the neon batteries.

slides.title: The Lab
slides.caption: Neon machines hum around the assistant.

slides.title: Experiment Card
slides.caption: Real science questions, read aloud.

slides.title: Power Up
slides.caption: Right answers charge the batteries.

slides.title: Full Power
slides.caption: Charge everything to complete the lab.

title: Space Safari
tagline: Zip between planets and meet the animals of space.
description: An audio-first adventure through the solar system: listen to a clue and choose the matching planet or space fact.
instructions: Listen to the clue (tap the speaker to replay).
Choose the matching picture.
Visit all 10 stops on your safari map.

slides.title: Blast Off
slides.caption: The safari ship leaves the neon pad.

slides.title: Planet Stop
slides.caption: Listen to a clue about the planet.

slides.title: Pick The Match
slides.caption: Tap the picture that fits the clue.

slides.title: Safari Map
slides.caption: Every stop stamps your map.

title: Colour Castle
tagline: Paint a neon castle, your way.
description: A relaxed creative canvas: paint glowing shapes onto the castle, then show your masterpiece to the kingdom.
instructions: Choose a neon colour from the palette.
Paint inside (or outside!) the lines however you like.
Press Finish when your artwork is done to save it as a level.

slides.title: Blank Castle
slides.caption: A grey castle waiting for colour.

slides.title: Neon Palette
slides.caption: Eight glowing colours to play with.

slides.title: Free Paint
slides.caption: No rules - paint anywhere you like.

slides.title: Gallery Wall
slides.caption: Finished art joins the royal gallery.

title: Doodle Dash
tagline: Draw the shape before the clock runs out!
description: A speedy sketching game: a shape pops up and you doodle it in neon before the timer bar empties.
instructions: Look at the shape on the card.
Draw it on the canvas with your chosen colour.
Finish before the timer bar empties to score big.

slides.title: Shape Card
slides.caption: A glowing shape appears.

slides.title: Dash Draw
slides.caption: Sketch it fast in neon ink.

slides.title: Timer Bar
slides.caption: Beat the clock for bonus points.

slides.title: Doodle Wall
slides.caption: Every dash lands on the wall.

title: Code Crayon
tagline: Draw a path the robot can follow.
description: Give simple step-by-step instructions - up, down, left, right - and the robot crayon follows your code to the star.
instructions: Look at where the robot starts and where the star is.
Tap arrow tiles to build your instruction list.
Press Run to watch the robot follow your code.

slides.title: Grid Start
slides.caption: Robot and star appear on the grid.

slides.title: Arrow Tiles
slides.caption: Build a chain of direction commands.

slides.title: Run It
slides.caption: Watch the robot follow your code.

slides.title: Star Reached
slides.caption: Collect the star to complete the level.

title: Robot Route
tagline: Plan the cleverest route through the maze.
description: Advanced grid puzzles: sequence turns, loops of movement and obstacle avoidance to guide the rover home.
instructions: Study the maze and the obstacles.
Build a command sequence with arrows.
Shorter, correct sequences earn higher scores.

slides.title: Maze Map
slides.caption: Walls and obstacles glow on the grid.

slides.title: Sequence Builder
slides.caption: Order your commands carefully.

slides.title: Rover Launch
slides.caption: The rover follows your plan step by step.

slides.title: Home Base
slides.caption: Shorter correct routes score higher.

title: Logic Lanterns
tagline: Switch the lights on with pure logic.
description: Grid-based logic puzzles: work out which lantern to switch next using clues and deduction.
instructions: Read the clue for the level.
Tap the lantern you think the clue points to.
Solve all clues to light the festival.

slides.title: Dark Festival
slides.caption: The lantern street waits for light.

slides.title: Clue Card
slides.caption: One clue points to the right lantern.

slides.title: Switch On
slides.caption: Tap to light it up with a neon burst.

slides.title: Full Street
slides.caption: Light them all to finish the festival.
